lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular spot clusters arranged in vertical columns immediately posterior to the gill slits, transitioning to a sparser, staggered grid distribution towards the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like alignment on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature is visible above the pectoral fin, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal edge and lower values/shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense population of small-diameter high-luminance spots localized on the surface of the visible pectoral fin, contrasting with the larger diameter spots on the main body flank.
